headline: Argentine assets slide and central bank pauses dollar buys amid Brazilian market stress
summary: Argentine sovereign bonds fell as JP Morgan country risk rose to 763 points amid spillovers from Brazilian market volatility. The Central Bank of Argentina paused foreign exchange reserve purchases for a third straight session.
why: Argentina's financial markets remain sensitive to regional trade spillovers, currency fluctuations, and foreign exchange reserves.

impacts.name: Argentine Sovereign Bonds
impacts.why: Regional contagion from Brazilian asset sell-offs pushed Argentine risk premiums higher.

why_moved: Regional market spillovers from Brazil weakened investor sentiment toward Argentine debt and equity securities.
